functions.name: BeginFeedback
functions.signature: BeginFeedback(Graph Builder, In Buffer Size, In Feature Level)
functions.docs: Shader parameters needed when writing virtual texture feedback from GPU.

functions.name: EndFeedback
functions.docs: End a virtual texture feedback scope.

functions.name: GetFeedbackShaderParams
functions.docs:
Get virtual texture feedback parameters to use for binding to any shader that is sampling virtual textures.
This version uses an internal scene frame counter, and the project default feedback tile size.
This is only valid within a BeginFeedback()/EndFeedback() scope.

functions.name: UpdateViewUniformShaderParameters
functions.signature: UpdateViewUniformShaderParameters(In Params, View Uniform Shader Parameters)
functions.docs: Helper to copy the virtual texture feedback shader parameters into the view parameters to be bound in the view uniform buffer.
